about: Virar East is a fast-growing township and residential belt at the northern end of Mumbai's Western Suburbs, served by the Virar railway terminus and bus depot, home to large integrated townships like Global City and Yashwant Viva, and bordered by the Western Express Highway. It is one of the most affordable housing belts in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

faq.question: What is Virar East known for?
faq.answer: Virar East is known for its large affordable integrated townships like Global City and Yashwant Viva, direct access to the Western Express Highway (NH-48), the Virar bus depot, and proximity to the famous Jivdani Temple hill. It is one of the fastest-growing residential and township belts in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Virar East?
faq.answer: Virar East comes under pin code 401305, covering localities like Chandansar, Bolinj East, Manvel Pada and the eastern township belt.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Virar East?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Virar East are Global City, Phoenix/Yashwant Viva township, Chandansar, Bolinj East, Manvel Pada, Fulpada and the highway/bus-depot belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Virar East?
faq.answer: Property prices in Virar East range from ₹25 lakh for a 1BHK in Chandansar/Manvel Pada to ₹45–65 lakh for a 2BHK in Global City, and ₹65–85 lakh for premium 2BHK/3BHK in newer Yashwant Viva/Phoenix townships. Rental rates range from ₹6,500 to ₹16,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Virar East?
faq.answer: Virar East is served by the Virar terminus of Western Railway's suburban line (75–90 min to Churchgate), the Virar bus depot for ST and VVMC buses, feeder auto rickshaws, direct access to the Western Express Highway (NH-48), and the upcoming Virar–Alibaug Multimodal Corridor and Bullet Train station.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Virar East?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Virar East include Sai Multispeciality Hospital, Sparsh Hospital, Riddhi Vinayak Critical Care, Platinum Hospital and several VVMC and trust-run clinics serving the Global City and Chandansar belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Virar East?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Virar East include Rustomjee Cambridge International School, Global City public schools, St. John the Baptist High School, Vidya Mandir High School and Universal/CBSE schools serving the township belt.
